settings.heading: Personalised support for your next teacher move.
settings.text: Three focused services. Each one ends with clear next steps, not generic advice.

settings.title: Canada Teacher Pathway Assessment
settings.text: For teachers trained outside Canada who want to teach there.
settings.details:
Solves: not knowing which province, documents or steps come first.

You receive: a profile summary, Canada Pathway Report, readiness score, document checklist, 90-day plan, 30-minute debrief and 30 days of limited follow-up.

Next: complete your intake after purchase. Your report is normally ready within 5 business days of a complete intake.

settings.title: Relocation Strategy
settings.text: For teachers choosing a country or preparing an international move.
settings.details:
Solves: conflicting advice and too many unknowns.

You receive: a focused strategy session on country fit, packages, documentation and timing, with written next steps.

Next: your scheduling link arrives by email after purchase.

settings.title: Contract Review
settings.text: For teachers holding an international teaching offer.
settings.details:
Solves: signing without knowing what's normal or missing.

You receive: a line-by-line review, red flags and missing clauses, salary and benefits benchmarking, and wording for your questions.

Next: your scheduling link arrives by email. Have your offer ready to share.

settings.question: Which service should I choose?
settings.answer: Aiming for Canada? Start with the Canada Teacher Pathway Assessment. Moving somewhere else, or still choosing? Choose Relocation Strategy. Holding an offer? Choose Contract Review.

settings.question: Do you guarantee a job or certification?
settings.answer: No. We're not a recruiter or a certification body. We help you make informed decisions and prepare well.

settings.question: Is this immigration advice?
settings.answer: No. Teacher Moves doesn't give immigration advice. For immigration questions, use official IRCC information or a licensed RCIC or lawyer.

settings.heading: Not ready for a service yet?
settings.text: Join the free community and ask your question there first.
